text:
Introduction
This document outlines the first level of inspection I1, to be performed 
on an monthly bases M1 as indicated in the above title block. The first draft initiated by eng. Mostafa 
Abd_Alla Beni Suef East 220kv Substation and approved at 15 Jan 2002.
Safety Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 equipment.
A work 
 permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 equipment.
Tools and Equipment
Safety equipment 
 "belt, shoes,...,etc", 6 mm Allen 
 key, 13 mm spanner
Works to be Carried Out
Compressor
Check the level 
 of lubricating oil for the compressor, correspond to the mark on the dipstick.
Visually check 
 that the automatic drainage valve drains the condensate at the 
 end of pumping.
Read and 
 record the number of the operating hours (if provided with hour counter).
Manual drainage gradually 
 of tank condensate to check that the system pressure remains 
 more or less constant
Loosen the 
 manual condensate drain plug by the Allen key until all the air begins to 
 comes out. Leave to drain until all the condensate has come out.
Note: 
 If the ambient temperature is below zero, this operation must not be 
 carried out. During drainage of the condensate, the compressor may start 
 again, the circuit breaker may open due to low air pressure (or lock if preset 
 to do so)
Read and record the number of operations carried out
Read and record the pressure and density meter and record the pressure of the 
 SF6 gas in the chart
